verdict.rationale: React docs explicitly support adding React to an existing HTML page without rewriting the whole stack (react-docs-1, react-docs-12), implying no-bundler use, but the evidence never explicitly documents a <script>-tag/CDN embed or a build-tool-free workflow beyond an online sandbox (react-docs-20). missing for 10: explicit script-tag/CDN snippet, confirmation that no package manager is required, independent corroboration of no-build usage.
